name: Chaplaincy free pancake breakfasts
summary: Free weekly pancake breakfasts during trimester at Griffith's South Bank, Nathan and Logan campuses.
catches: South Bank Wednesdays 11:30am, Nathan Thursdays 9am, Logan Tuesdays 9am.

evidence.quote: Come and fill up on a free feed of pancakes cooked by a local faith group and powered by Griffith Chaplaincy.
